items.title: Request-Adaptive Execution for Efficient Hybrid LLM Inference
items.summary: Hybrid large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising way to combine the modeling capability of the Attention mechanism with the efficiency of state space models (SSMs). items.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
items.summary: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. items.title: PipeLink: Contract-Guided Linking of GPU Kernel Components
